title: Account Manager End-of-Week Report & Sync Prep

subsections.heading: A. Development
subsections.objective: Objective: Zero downtime or idle time for developers.

items.label: Developer Task Lock-In
items.text: Does TRI have his exact task queues locked in for Monday morning? (Mimi to attach a screenshot/link to the finalized project board for next week below).

items.label: Scope Creep & Upsell Tracking
items.text: Have any technical out-of-scope requests from the past week been flagged, documented, and passed to Account Management for upsell estimation?

items.label: Cross-Department Handovers
items.text: Have all technical assets or handovers required by other teams (e.g., SEO, Marketing) been delivered so no external campaigns are delayed?

subsections.heading: B. Account Management (AM) Sync
subsections.objective: Objective: Align internal delivery with client-facing expectations.

items.label: Client Deliverable Alignment
items.text: Have you synced with the Account Manager (Mimi) to review upcoming client deadlines, urgent requests, and report delivery statuses for next week?

items.label: Blocker Resolution
items.text: Are there any internal blockers preventing the delivery team from meeting CS team’s promises? If yes, what is the mitigation plan?

items.label: Weekly Updates Added to SD Friday
items.text: All team updates are added to SD Friday, this includes Client Service level updates, Development updates if applicable, SEO updates if applicable.

subsections.heading: C. SEO Department
subsections.objective: Objective: Maintain tight oversight on output, even with self-managing or remote staff.

items.label: Lead Alignment
items.text: Have you synced with Simon to confirm next week's core strategy and deliverables?

items.label: Task Delegation Audit
items.text: For team members reliant on the Lead for task assignments, have their next 3-5 days of work been mapped out? If no tasks are available, what is their explicit fallback optimization focus?

items.label: Tooling & Technical Support
items.text: Are all technical tools, scripts, or analyzers required by the SEO team fully functional and delivered?

subsections.objective: Objective: Ensure Monday morning kicks off with absolute structure, clarity, and zero technical friction.

items.label: Townhall Presentation Ready
items.text: Is the Monday Townhall presentation fully updated with the previous week's performance metrics, company wins, and the upcoming week's focus. SD Townhalls

items.label: Meeting Logistics & Links
items.text: Have all calendar invites for the upcoming week (especially the Townhall) been audited? Are valid, working video links attached, ensuring seamless access for both in-office and WFH staff?

items.label: Weekly WFH/In-Office Roster
items.text: Has the team’s attendance schedule for next week been mapped out so we know exactly who is remote and when?
